topic: What if you went back to 2010 with $100?

script.text: Here's how it works. You go to sleep in 2026, and wake up on the first of May, 2010. Same age. Same house. Same family. But the whole world is sixteen years behind you.
You keep every memory. Every price. Every headline. Every score.
You get one hundred dollars. Not a cent more.

The rules are simple. You can't bring anything back with you, except what's in your head. Nobody will believe you're from the future, so don't bother trying. And money you make here only counts if it survives until 2026.
And one more rule. Your memories are only right as long as the future stays the same. Change it too much, and what you remember stops being true. Remember that. It matters later.
This is what if you went back to 2010 with a hundred dollars.

science.claim: The iPhone 4 was unveiled on 7 June 2010.
science.working: Apple unveiled iPhone 4 at WWDC on 7 June 2010; it went on sale on 24 June 2010.
